title: AGF Team Note
description: A short prose note from the AGF team. Sits between major sections as a quiet interlude; closes with a hairline rule below the text. Simple headline + body structure — same edit controls as every other section (per-item click-to-edit, right-click menu for background images / inline figures / enhance / reorder).

section_label.description: Small eyebrow label above the headline (e.g., 'On the team'). Optional. Maps to the standard section eyebrow used by every section.

section_title.description: The note's headline (h2). Optional — leave empty for a body-only interlude. Maps to the standard section title used by every section.

body.description: The note's main prose. Markdown supported: **bold**, *italic*, blank lines for new paragraphs. Rendered in the grey Commissioner (var(--taupe), weight 300) — matching the hero subheadline.

appendix.description: markdown — supporting notes for the appendix

$comment: default_data is a custom extension (not part of JSON Schema). It is consumed by server/seed.js and server/migrations/sync_schemas.js to populate the section_schemas table with initial content.
